#Changelog

What changed in the bot API and the client libraries, newest first. Nothing here breaks a bot written for an earlier version.

#November 2026

The biggest update to the bot API so far. @disband/bot and disband-bot 0.3.0 cover everything below.

#New endpoints

Endpoint What it does
GET /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId One message, with a summary of its reactions.
GET /api/v1/channels/:id/messages?after= / ?around= Page forwards, or around a message, as well as backwards with before.
POST /api/v1/channels/:id/typing Show "is typing…" while your bot works on an answer.
GET /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId/reactions Every emoji on a message, with counts.
GET /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId/reactions/:emoji Who reacted with an emoji.
DELETE /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId/reactions Clear every reaction, or one emoji's with ?emoji=.
DELETE /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId/reactions/:emoji/:userId Remove one person's reaction.
GET /api/v1/channels/:forumId/posts A forum's posts.
POST /api/v1/channels/:forumId/posts Start a forum post.
GET /api/v1/users/@me The bot's own profile, status and scopes.
PATCH /api/v1/users/@me Set the bot's custom status.
GET /api/v1/users/@me/servers Every space the bot is in.
GET /api/v1/users/:id A member's public profile.

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/members also takes query, role and limit, to find members without fetching everyone.

See the API reference for the details of each.

#New gateway events

  • reactionAdd, reactionRemove
  • channelCreate, channelUpdate, channelDelete (forum posts included)
  • roleCreate, roleUpdate, roleDelete
  • serverUpdate
  • serverJoin, serverLeave and scopesUpdate, about the bot itself

#Fixes

  • Rate limits now match the docs. A pre-filter held every bot to 20 requests a minute on each server instance, well under the documented 120 reads and 60 writes. It now allows the full limit.
  • Missing things return 404. "Channel not found", "Message not found" and the like came back as 400 from some endpoints. They're 404 everywhere now, as the error table always said.
  • The event queue is tidied. Delivered events are kept for a day and undelivered ones for a week, so a bot that's been offline for a long time starts from recent events instead of a backlog.

#Client libraries 0.3.0

  • Methods for everything above: getMessage, sendTyping, listReactions, listReactionUsers, removeUserReaction, clearReactions, listForumPosts, createForumPost, fetchMe, setStatus, listServers and getUser (snake_case in Python).
  • listMessages takes after and around; listMembers takes query, role and limit.
  • 429s are retried for you. The libraries wait out Retry-After and try again, up to three times, before raising a rate limit error. Turn it off with retryRateLimits: false (retry_rate_limits=False).
  • The JavaScript package no longer depends on an old copy of itself.
